name: Adamawa Mortgage Bank
notes: Skipped: only reachable over an expired TLS certificate (not bypassed); image is a house icon without the bank name. NO Wayback copy exists (CDX and availability API return nothing for the domain), so the Wayback route suggested in GAPS.md is not possible. The live site's TLS certificate is expired (SEC_E_CERT_EXPIRED); the files return 200 image/png only with certificate verification disabled (curl -k), and plain http redirects to https. The importer must fetch with TLS verification off or the owner should grab it manually. logo.png is 1532x580 RGBA: house icon plus 'RC No. 7167143' text, with no bank name. logoround.png is 1585x1585, the same house icon on a white circle. No Apple app found.

name: ABU Microfinance Bank
aliases: Ahmadu Bello University Microfinance Bank Nig. Ltd
notes: Official Facebook page 'Ahmadu Bello University Microfinance Bank Nig. Ltd | Zaria', about 2.7k followers. The profile picture is a 188x188 JPEG, the ABUMFB emblem (green arch with pink figures and ABUMFB text); not a silhouette. No Apple or Google Play app. Do not confuse with ABUCOOP MFB (com.abucoopmfb.abucoopmfbmobile), which is a different institution.

The og:image aso_logo1.jpg (180x68) is only archived at 2025-12-16, possibly after the hijack, so I did not use it. No Apple app found.

name: County Finance
notes: Domain countyfinanceng.com found through the ELAN contact list; the live site no longer responds. The logo is a Wayback copy (2023-06-10) of the stacked lockup, 375x347: gold/brown 'C' orb with 'COUNTY Finance'. The horizontal header version (300x80) is at https://web.archive.org/web/20220117001041im_/https://www.countyfinanceng.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/logo-big.png. The mark is the 180x180 site icon. Note: the official Facebook page facebook.com/countyfinancelimited (Ikeja) now shows a newer, different gold 'C' mark (graph.facebook.com/countyfinancelimited/picture?type=large, 200x200), so the brand may have been refreshed. 49 Wemco Road, Ogba, Ikeja.

aliases: Ebonyi State University Microfinance Bank Ltd

name: Excel Microfinance Bank
notes: LOW CONFIDENCE on identity. I could not confirm that code 090678 'EXCEL FINANCE BANK' is the live site excelmfb.com ('Excel Microfinance Bank Limited', 1 Hospital Road, Sango Eruwa, Oyo). No other Excel bank or finance company was found. The logo is tiny: 82x90 RGBA, a circular 'emb' badge with a bird. The site's favicon.png returns 404. No Apple or Google Play app.

name: FUTMINNA Microfinance Bank
notes: Located at the Federal University of Technology, Minna, Niger State. No logo found. Tried: Apple ('FUTMINNA', 'FUT Minna', 'Minna microfinance'); Google Play ('com.futminna' is the university's app, not the bank's); web search for a Facebook/Instagram/X/LinkedIn page (only university accounts); guessed domains futminnamfb.com/.ng and futmfb.com (none exist). name: Garun Mallam Microfinance Bank
notes: Garun Mallam town, Kano State. No website, app or social page found. Tried: Apple ('Garun Mallam', 'Garun'); Google Play; web search for a Facebook page; guessed domains garunmallammfb.com and gmmfb.com.

name: Goodnews Microfinance Bank
notes: Ibadan, Oyo (RC 395695). Goodnews MFB is the licensed bank that issues account numbers (NUBANs) for Prospa (getprospa.com) and was reportedly acquired by Prospa in 2024. The Prospa logo is a different brand, so I did not use it. The owner could consider sameBrandAs 'prospa' if transfers to this code are mostly Prospa accounts. goodnewsmfb.com in Wayback (2021-2025) is empty or a parked '/lander' page. The Facebook page 'Goodnews Mfbank' (id 100039325844459) has only the default silhouette avatar, so I rejected it. No Apple app; Google Play com.gnmfb.mobile is Good Neighbours MFB, a different bank.

name: Grants Microfinance Bank
notes: Head office in Gwagwalada, Abuja FCT (from the archived contact-us page). grantsmfb.com is now a parked Sedo domain, so both images are Wayback copies from 2024-07-15. The logo is the site's 'grants-logo-5.png' (1424x532): green 'GRANTS MFB' text in a thin blue box above a gold cowrie shell, on a dark gradient background. It is a banner-style image, not a clean transparent logo, so medium confidence. The mark is the site icon/header logo: a gold cowrie shell, 150x106 JPEG, not square. No Apple or Google Play app.
